run_pipeline_cosmos_video2world: run the CosmosVideoToWorldPipeline to generate video from an input image and text prompt
run_video_conditioned_generation: run the pipeline with video conditioning to extend a video sequence using a text prompt
encode_text_prompts: encode text prompts into T5 hidden state embeddings with classifier-free guidance support
prepare_video_latents: prepare latent variables from input video with conditioning masks and noise augmentation for diffusion
denoise_video_latents: run the denoising loop with EMD Euler scheduler to generate extended video frames from latents
